name: Dawn Regalia (Drakneta signature)
description: an ornate floor-length dawn gown of {{PRIMARY}} and arc-white silk with a fitted bodice embroidered with {{METAL}} lightning forks and copper coils, a high winged collar of {{METAL}} plates, long sleeves of sheer white gauze edged in gold wire, and a skirt of rippling ribbons that crackle and whip upward; sweetheart neckline
notes: Worn in the Dawn scene: a highly decorative, flowing gown built to move while rising from the Sundering.
